The dashboard reads its data from one folder: CSV files with the
coverage, cases and locations, and GeoJSON files with the county and
school district boundaries. You start it with that folder:

```r
library(epiviewVPD)
run_dashboard(data_dir = "path/to/your/data", config = "my_settings.R")
```

The package comes with a complete, made-up example folder in this format.
It is the quickest way to see what each file looks like, and a good
starting point for your own:

```r
example_data_dir()   # where the example folder is
file.copy(list.files(example_data_dir(), full.names = TRUE), "my_data")
```

## Files

| File | One row per | Used for |
|------|-------------|----------|
| `counties.csv` | county | County coverage map, statewide rate |
| `county_boundaries.geojson` | county | County outlines |
| `schools.csv` | school | School points, school details, Summary tables |
| `grades.csv` | school and grade | Grade-level table and chart in school details |
| `facilities.csv` | child care program | Child care points, details and tables |
| `districts.csv` | school district | School district view of the map |
| `district_boundaries.geojson` | school district | District outlines |
| `cases.csv` | county and year (and age group) | Historical cases map and table |
| `healthcare_centers.csv` | healthcare center | Healthcare centers on the proximity map |

This version of the dashboard needs every file. Within a file, a column is
either:

- **Required**: the dashboard stops with a message naming the file and
  the column if it is missing.
- **Optional**: you can leave the column out, or leave cells blank. The
  dashboard shows the value as not available. (Some school details still
  show "NA" for these.)

Columns the dashboard doesn't know are ignored, so you can leave extra
columns in.

## General rules

- **CSV files** are comma-separated, UTF-8, with a header row. Column
  names are lower case, as written on this page.
- **IDs are text.** Leading zeros are kept (`"0001"`). If you prepare
  files in Excel, format ID columns as text first. The dashboard never
  changes an ID: a school's `district_id` has to be written exactly like
  the `district_id` in `districts.csv`.
- **Coverage is given, not calculated.** Every file with coverage needs
  `enroll` and `full_vax_pct`, and the dashboard shows the percentage as
  given. `enroll` is the enrollment the percentage is based on, from the
  same report. Counts such as `full_vax` are optional.
- **Percentages** are 0–100, not 0–1 (`92.4`, not `0.924`).
- **Suppressed values**: a percentage may be written the way it was
  published, such as `">95"` or `"<5"`. The dashboard shows it as written.
  For map colors and sorting it counts it one point past its number
  (`">95"` as 96, `"<5"` as 4).
- **Missing values**: leave the cell blank. Don't use 0 for "no data":
  0 is read as a real 0.
- **Counties** are named without "County" (`"Clear Lake"`, not
  `"Clear Lake County"`), spelled as in `county_boundaries.geojson`.
  Upper and lower case don't matter; the dashboard uses the spelling in
  the boundaries file.
- **Coordinates** are decimal degrees (WGS 84, as from a GPS or a web
  map): `latitude` 44.97, `longitude` -93.26.
- **Boundaries** are GeoJSON polygons with one property that names them
  (`county_name` or `district_id`). Any coordinate system works; the
  dashboard converts it. To write a boundary file from a shapefile in R:
  `sf::st_write(sf::st_read("counties.shp"), "county_boundaries.geojson")`.

## `counties.csv`

Vaccine coverage for each county, from the schools in it. The county map
is colored by `full_vax_pct`.

| Column | | Description |
|--------|---|-------------|
| `county_name` | Required | County name, as in `county_boundaries.geojson` |
| `enroll` | Required | Students enrolled |
| `full_vax_pct` | Required | Percent fully vaccinated |
| `full_vax` | Optional | Students fully vaccinated. With it, the map title shows the statewide rate: total `full_vax` over total `enroll` |
| `students_of_color_pct` | Optional | Percent students of color, of the enrollment it was counted against; shown in the county pop-up |
| `frl_eligible_pct` | Optional | Percent eligible for free or reduced-price meals, likewise; shown in the county pop-up |

## `county_boundaries.geojson`

One polygon per county, with a `county_name` property. Every county in
`counties.csv` needs a boundary. A county with a boundary but no row in
`counties.csv` is drawn without coverage.

## `schools.csv`

| Column | | Description |
|--------|---|-------------|
| `school_id` | Required | Unique ID; links to `grades.csv` |
| `school_name` | Required | Name shown in the dashboard |
| `latitude` | Required | |
| `longitude` | Required | |
| `enroll` | Required | Students enrolled |
| `full_vax_pct` | Required | Percent fully vaccinated |
| `full_vax` | Optional | Students fully vaccinated |
| `partial_vax` | Optional | Students partially vaccinated or with no doses |
| `partial_vax_pct` | Optional | Percent partially vaccinated or with no doses |
| `medical_pct` | Optional | Percent with a medical exemption |
| `nonmedical_pct` | Optional | Percent with a non-medical exemption |
| `school_type` | Optional | Any label, such as `Public`, `Private`, `Charter`; shown in pop-ups and tables. For `Charter` schools the details say district coverage isn't available, and `home_languages` is labeled as the school's own |
| `grade_range` | Optional | Grades taught, such as `K-5`; shown in the school pop-up |
| `address` | Optional | Street address |
| `county_name` | Optional | If left out, the county is worked out from the coordinates |
| `district_id` | Optional | The school's district, as in `districts.csv`. Leave it blank for schools outside any district |
| `contact_info` | Optional | Contacts to show, such as `Health office: name@school.org` |
| `home_languages` | Optional | Most common home languages in the school's district (for charter schools, in the school), comma-separated |

## `grades.csv`

| Column | | Description |
|--------|---|-------------|
| `school_id` | Required | As in `schools.csv` |
| `grade` | Required | `K` (or `0`) and `1` to `12` |
| `enroll` | Required | Students enrolled in the grade |
| `full_vax_pct` | Required | Percent fully vaccinated |
| `full_vax` | Optional | Students fully vaccinated |
| `partial_vax_pct` | Optional | Percent partially vaccinated or with no doses |
| `medical_pct` | Optional | Percent with a medical exemption |
| `nonmedical_pct` | Optional | Percent with a non-medical exemption |

## `facilities.csv`

Child care programs.

| Column | | Description |
|--------|---|-------------|
| `facility_id` | Required | Unique ID, such as a license number |
| `facility_name` | Required | Name shown in the dashboard |
| `latitude` | Required | Leave both coordinates blank for a program without a location; it is left off the maps |
| `longitude` | Required | |
| `enroll` | Required | Children enrolled |
| `full_vax_pct` | Required | Percent fully vaccinated, of `enroll_eligible` if given |
| `full_vax` | Optional | Children fully vaccinated |
| `enroll_eligible` | Optional | Children old enough for the vaccine |
| `county_name` | Optional | If left out, the county is worked out from the coordinates |

## `districts.csv`

| Column | | Description |
|--------|---|-------------|
| `district_id` | Required | Unique ID, as in `district_boundaries.geojson` and `schools.csv` |
| `district_name` | Required | Name shown in the dashboard |
| `enroll` | Required | Students enrolled |
| `full_vax_pct` | Required | Percent fully vaccinated |
| `full_vax` | Optional | Students fully vaccinated |

## `district_boundaries.geojson`

One polygon per school district, with a `district_id` property. Every
district in `districts.csv` needs a boundary.

## `cases.csv`

| Column | | Description |
|--------|---|-------------|
| `county_name` | Required | County name, as in `county_boundaries.geojson` |
| `year` | Required | |
| `n_cases` | Required | Cases in that county and year (and age group) |
| `age_group` | Optional | One of `0-4`, `5-11`, `12-19`, `20-49`, `50+` or `Unknown`. Without it, only the "All Ages" view has cases |

## `healthcare_centers.csv`

| Column | | Description |
|--------|---|-------------|
| `name` | Required | Name shown on the proximity map |
| `latitude` | Required | |
| `longitude` | Required | |

## What the dashboard checks

When it starts, the dashboard reads every file and stops with one message
that lists every problem it found, such as:

```
The data in "my_data" can't be loaded:
  - schools.csv: column enroll should hold numbers but has "n/a"
  - facilities.csv: 2 row(s) have coordinates outside -90..90 / -180..180 (latitude and longitude swapped?)
  - schools.csv: 1 county name(s) not in county_boundaries.geojson: Clear Lake County (leave out "County")
  - schools.csv: 1 school_id value(s) appear more than once: S00007
```

It checks for:

- missing files and missing required columns
- cells that should be numbers but aren't
- county names that aren't in `county_boundaries.geojson`, and districts
  that aren't in `district_boundaries.geojson`
- IDs and county names that appear more than once
- rows with only one of `latitude` and `longitude`, or with coordinates
  out of range
